channel.title: The Brussels Times
channel.description: Latest Brussels posts from The Brussels Times.

item.title: Rejected for being ‘too old’ or wearing a headscarf: Discrimination on Brussels’ job market persists
item.description: A candidate can have the right qualifications, the right experience and a strong CV – but never make it to the interview.

item.title: About 500 protest against organised crime in Brussels
item.description: As shootings have reemerged in the area, hundreds of residents took to the streets to speak up against the ongoing drug conflict.

item.title: Woman dies in suspicious circumstances in Brussels
item.description: An investigation has been opened after police found a deceased woman in a flat on Friday morning. The circumstances of her death are still unclear.

item.title: Head-on crash with police injures two in Brussels
item.description: Two people were fleeing a police check on a scooter when they crashed into another, parked vehicle from the front.

item.title: Suspect escapes after stabbing in Brussels park
item.description: A person was stabbed yesterday evening after a heated argument got out of hand. The attacker fled the scene before the police arrived.

item.title: Cars catch fire in Brussels, one resident injured
item.description: A Brussels resident suffered leg injuries after jumping out of a first-floor apartment upon noticing a fire. They are being treated in hospital.

item.title: 'Retired' sheep called in by Ixelles to mow cemetery lawns
item.description: Eight sheep are part of the Ixelles eco-grazing project this year: Lactose, Rayban, Pils, Domino, Katimini, Maria, Juliette, Puyu.

item.title: Summer's over: Brussels to make school surroundings safer
item.description: "We are taking concrete steps to address the infrastructure, speed limits and organisation of journeys."

item.title: SNCB unveils special anniversary display in Brussels station
item.description: SNCB will celebrate its 100th anniversary by recalling some of the most iconic carriages of the past. Visitors can enter the displayed trains for free.

item.title: Brussels cat rescuers given new large shelter to help with rising demand
item.description: The organisation combats uncontrolled reproduction and poor living conditions among cats by catching as many strays as possible and having them neutered.

item.title: Belgium misses EU deadline on nature restoration due to Brussels Region
item.description: The federal and Flemish plans are ready, but Wallonia and Brussels have not yet completed theirs.

item.title: City of Brussels mayor hit by conflict of interest complaint over €750 million casino deal
item.description: A conflict of interest accusation was levied against Philippe Close after the City of Brussels granted use of the Grand Casino to a betting company.

item.title: Brussels' Palais de Justice façade finally free after over 20 years
item.description: Some work remains to be completed after delays partly caused by several heatwaves this summer, but the iconic courthouse's façade is now scaffolding-free.

item.title: What to do in Brussels this weekend: 28 - 30 August
item.description: From a cider party to the city's final summer festival of the season, here's what's happening in Brussels this weekend.

item.title: Forest Sounds celebrates 10 years with special Brussels showcase
item.description: The well-loved Brussels festival at Forest Abbey will feature Brussels-based artists, with music from around the world.

item.title: Demonstration by FGTB at Brussels headquarters of MR and Les Engagés
item.description: On Friday morning, several dozen activists from the Union FGTB staged a symbolic protest outside the headquarters of the MR and Les Engagés in Brussels.

item.title: Iconic restaurant tram returns to take you on a scenic route through Brussels
item.description: Whether as a couple, a group of four or a larger party, guests are served a menu created by a renowned chef while touring Brussels' most beautiful neighbourhoods.

item.title: Exhibition of iconic Chinese dissident artist Ai Weiwei arrives in Brussels
item.description: The overview exhibition features both artist's emblematic works from the 1990s contemporary works.

item.title: Seth Troxler and Folamour in Brussels for open-air canal rave on Saturday
item.description: The Quai de Heembeek at the Port of Brussels will host 5,000 ravers for one of the last open-air parties of the summer.

item.title: Ten nursing home residents in Brussels suffer smoke inhalation in hallway fire
item.description: A corridor fire forced the evacuation of about 20 residents from a care home in Evere early on Thursday.
